answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of the scaled RNN models on various tasks, including language modeling, zero-shot common-sense reasoning, and long-context understanding tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in tasks such as language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and retrieval-based question answering, which involve natural language generation.

answer_2.quote: Following , our common-sense reasoning evaluation includes Wikitext , LAMBADA , PIQA , HellaSwag , WinoGrande , ARCeasy (ARC-e) and ARC-challenge (ARC-c) , SIQA , and BoolQ . Real-world retrieval tasks include FDA , SWDE , and SQuAD . The above tasks are evaluated using lm-eval .
